definitions.gloss: to squeeze out; to wring out
definitions.explanation: To physically twist or squeeze something to extract its contents.

definitions.gloss: to come up with; to devise with effort
definitions.explanation: To produce an idea, answer, or solution through great mental effort, as if wringing it out of one's brain. Implies difficulty and strain.

examples.japanese: ⟦チューブ→チューブ：11586_chuubu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捻|ひね}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I squeezed out the last drop from the tube.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑巾|ぞうきん}→雑巾：04408_zoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捻|ひね}り{出|だ}すよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。

examples.english: I squeezed out the last bit of toothpaste and used it.

examples.english: I finally came up with an idea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捻|ひね}り{出|だ}した。

examples.english: I came up with a strained excuse and managed to get through the situation.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 (figurative) is more common in everyday speech. The word vividly conveys the effort and strain involved in producing something, as if physically twisting it out. Often used with ⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧ (wisdom), ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧ (idea), ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧ (answer), and ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧ (excuse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捻|ひね}り{出|だ}す (to rack one's brains)
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捻|ひね}り{出|だ}す (to come up with an idea)
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捻|ひね}り{出|だ}す (to come up with an excuse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す→絞り出す：19545_shiboridasu⟧: to squeeze out — very similar, but more emphasis on squeezing than twisting
- {思|おも}いつく: to think of — neutral; lacks the connotation of effort and struggle
